svg.aria-label: Typical protein and antibody screening workflow

text.tspan: From DNA constructs to functional evidence: the life science tools behind each step
Example: sequence-defined antibody candidates screened against a protein target
AI learning needs depth per molecule
Potential constraint: comparable, reproducible assay data
Sequence + assay context + results → next design cycle
Automation + data orchestration span every step
Wet lab = build + test. AI may test fewer molecules while increasing characterization depth per molecule.
LST demand depends on molecule count × assay depth × net inputs per assay; instrument investment is separate.
Illustrative workflow; assays may run in parallel. * Scale-dependent. † Expression comes from stage 2. Supplier examples and primary sources: SOURCES.md.
